_: CODING VOCABULARY v2 (2026-08-25, spec-owner amendment after the P4 tripwire; the v1 defect was under-determined place selection — Opus-vs-Opus 0.467 pattern-exact). Changes: a mandatory single PRIMARY place; secondaries only with an explicit quote; per-pair tie-breaks; worked examples. Pattern (for analysis) = primary + sorted(secondaries) + verb; primary-only granularity is also analyzed.
rules: PRIMARY (exactly one): the place without which the definition collapses — remove that constraint and the definition no longer picks out its norms. Ask: what is this behaviour ABOUT?
SECONDARY (0-2): add a place ONLY if the definition text EXPLICITLY restricts it — you must be able to quote the restricting phrase. Implied or usual restrictions do not count.

TIE-BREAKS: object_sphere vs beneficiary — beneficiary only when the definition is about WHO is affected/protected; object_sphere when it is about WHOSE matter/decision is acted on. governed_quality vs act — governed_quality when the definition names a property of outputs (accuracy, tone, neutrality); act when it names a kind of doing (refuse, comply, disclose). exception_structure only when the definition is about HOW conflicts/exceptions are resolved, not merely because the text contains an 'unless'. condition only when the definition restricts WHEN norms apply (a circumstance class), not as a paraphrase of the behaviour itself.
VERB: select unless the definition explicitly asks for compliance-checking (check), ranking/priority (order), conflict-finding (compare), or coverage/completeness (complete).

worked_examples.definition: The model should respect users' right to make decisions within their own lives and purview, even where it disagrees.
worked_examples.why: About WHOSE matter is acted on (the user's decisions) — object_sphere primary; no quoted restriction of act, quality, or condition; 'even where it disagrees' is colour, not a place constraint.

worked_examples.definition: When values or goals conflict, the model should navigate the tradeoff through structured prioritization rather than abandoning one consideration entirely.
worked_examples.why: About HOW conflicts are resolved (structured prioritization) — exception_structure primary; 'when values or goals conflict' explicitly restricts the circumstance class — condition secondary, quoted.

worked_examples.definition: The model should assess potential harms and calibrate its caution to their probability, scale, and severity.
worked_examples.why: Names a property of conduct (calibrated caution) — governed_quality primary; 'to their probability, scale, and severity' quotes a circumstance-scaling restriction — condition secondary.
